context: A host at an indoor climbing centre gives a new-member safety briefing.

lines.text: Now turn to Section Two. You will hear a talk for new members at an indoor climbing centre.
Questions eleven to fifteen. Complete the notes below. Write no more than two words and/or a number for each answer. First, you have some time to look at questions eleven to fifteen.
Now listen and answer questions eleven to fifteen.
Welcome to Ashfield Walls. I'm your host for this morning's new-member briefing.
The centre is open from seven a.m. to ten p.m. every day except Tuesday, when we close for bolt checks.
Your first supervised session lasts ninety minutes, including kit check — ninety minutes, not a two-hour block.
You must be at least fourteen to climb without an adult on site.
Please bring a chalk bag — we lend harnesses, but we do not lend chalk.
Tap water is free at the lobby fountain; please don't take bottles onto the walls.

Questions sixteen to twenty. Which part of the site is each facility in? Choose the correct letter, A, B or C. The options are on your question paper only. First, you have some time to look at questions sixteen to twenty.
Now listen and answer questions sixteen to twenty.
Look at the site layout in your booklet. I'll walk you through it without reading the letters.
If you start in the east hall, that's where the beginner walls are — shorter routes with extra mats.
lines.note: Paper: A East hall; B West hall; C Roof terrace. Beginner walls = east hall.

lines.text: Shoe hire is in the west hall, beside the desk — not in the east, which is members only after six.
Follow the stairs to the roof terrace and you'll reach the outdoor boulders, used only in dry weather.
The first-aid room is also in the west hall, behind shoe hire — not upstairs.
And the day lockers sit in the east hall by the fire door, so bags are not left at the west desk.
I'll take questions at the end of the tour. Thank you.
That is the end of Section Two. Now turn to Section Three.
